manifesto.headline1: YOU'RE NOT CHOOSING AN INDUSTRIAL SPACE.
manifesto.headline2: YOU'RE CHOOSING HOW YOU'RE GOING TO OPERATE.
manifesto.p1: Choosing industrial space isn't buying square footage; it's deciding where your company will operate for the next ten or twenty years.
manifesto.p2: That decision deserves certainty: power available from day one, guaranteed water, access that works, roadways designed for tractor-trailers, and a park manager who answers when you need them.
manifesto.p3: True Cienega is designed around your operation: how your trucks come in, how your people work, how you grow when the time comes.

infra.p1: TRUE CIENEGA INDUSTRIAL PARK has its electrical project filed directly with CFE — 6,000 KVA for the park, first phase in process — guaranteed water supply through cisterns, redundant fiber optics, and storm drainage designed with channels and crossings that protect your operation in any season.
infra.p2: Access points, truck courts and roadways were laid out for heavy traffic and smooth tractor-trailer circulation, with a guard house, CCTV, controlled access and perimeter fencing.
infra.p3: Behind all of it, professional management that maintains, monitors and responds — because a park isn't delivered once: it's operated every day.

spec1.title: 6,000 KVA
spec1.text: Electrical project filed with CFE for the park.

spec3.title: NATURAL GAS AND FIBER OPTICS
spec3.text: Provisions for natural gas and fiber optics according to your operation.

flex.title: The most flexible range on the market.
flex.p1: It's rare for a single park to accommodate a company that needs 200,000 square feet on a lease and another that wants to buy 15 hectares to build its campus. True Cienega can.
flex.p2: That flexibility isn't an accident: it's how we designed the park to support companies at different stages of their growth. You start by leasing and then you buy. You buy three hectares and then you expand.

quality.title: Built to last, designed to work.
quality.lead: Class A specifications in every building:
quality.item4: Efficient lighting and layouts that prioritize flow over ornament
quality.p: Quality doesn't show up in the renderings: it shows up ten years in, when the building still works the way it did on day one. That's the standard we build to.

faq.q1: Does the park already have power available, or is it just a promise?
faq.a1: The electrical project is filed directly with CFE, with the first phase in process. It isn't a future promise — it's a process already under way.
faq.q2: How long does a build-to-suit building take?
faq.a2: Delivery dates are defined from contract signing, based on the size and specifications of your building.
faq.q3: What if my operation grows faster than expected?
faq.a3: The industrial buildings are designed with expansion in mind, and you can acquire additional adjacent area while it remains available.
faq.q4: Is it better to lease or to buy?
faq.a4: It depends on your operation. Leasing frees up capital; buying builds equity. Tell us your case and we'll help you decide.
faq.q5: Who manages the park after the sale or the delivery?
faq.a5: True Developments designs, builds and operates every project, including managing the park once it's delivered.
faq.q6: Are contracts in pesos or in dollars?
faq.a6: Build-to-suit building contracts are in USD, structured for long-term operations.

developer.p1: True Developments is a Monterrey-based real estate developer with more than 18 years of experience developing distribution facilities, industrial buildings and industrial parks in Mexico.
developer.p2: We design, build and operate reliable industrial spaces, where companies operate with certainty and where people and communities thrive.
developer.p3: Our portfolio exceeds 100,000 m² of owned properties leased to companies such as PepsiCo, Vitro, Nemak and Mission Foods, plus more than 200,000 m² built for clients including HEINEKEN México, Caterpillar, Henkel, Polaris and other leading companies.
